reference: Current source with schemaSerde=false, HTTP 1.x; not a historical release or Git HEAD checkout.

findings.title: Trailing slash URI templates disagree with label extraction
findings.legacy: TrailingInput returns 200 for /trailing/rex; greedy /a/b/ preserves the final slash in the captured value.
findings.schema: Returns 400 without the template trailing slash; greedy /a/b/ captures a/b.
findings.note: This is the supplied example, independently reproduced in this checkout; it is not counted as a newly discovered issue.

findings.title: Prefix-header strings are not trimmed
findings.legacy: one_or_none_bytes trims whitespace: " value " becomes "value".
findings.schema: StringMapDeserializer returns the original " value ".

findings.title: Prefix-header media strings bypass decoding and validation
findings.legacy: Decodes base64 e30= to {}; rejects malformed base64 and decoded invalid UTF-8. Empty media header panics after tokenization yields no value.
findings.schema: Returns raw header text, accepts malformed encodings, and accepts the empty value.
findings.note: The empty-value case is a legacy panic, not a recommendation to reproduce the panic.

findings.title: Prefix-header media strings are not encoded on output
findings.legacy: A MediaMap value {} becomes header x-meta-key: e30=.
findings.schema: Emits x-meta-key: {}.

findings.title: Query timestamp-list member format precedence differs
findings.legacy: HttpBindingIndex resolves the list binding format; epoch values 0 and 1.5 are rejected here.
findings.schema: Resolves the element schema timestampFormat(epoch-seconds) and accepts them.
findings.note: Model has @timestampFormat on the list member, not on the operation input collection member.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON member followed by null preserves the previous value
findings.legacy: {"text":"a","text":null} leaves text unset.
findings.schema: Skips the null before the consumer callback; text remains a.

findings.title: Document null is lost
findings.legacy: Document-valued null is Some(Document::Null), including a REST document payload.
findings.schema: Document member or payload becomes None.
findings.note: payload-document-1 exists only in rest-json; body-document-null covers all JSON protocols.

findings.title: Overflowing finite JSON numbers become infinity
findings.legacy: Rejects 1e400/-1e400 with HTTP 400.
findings.schema: Accepts and exposes positive/negative infinity to the handler.

findings.title: Integral decimal precision differs
findings.legacy: 9007199254740993.0 becomes long 9007199254740992 through legacy floating-point number conversion.
findings.schema: Preserves 9007199254740993 with parse_integral_decimal.
findings.note: Schema preserves more precision. This is a compatibility difference, not an assertion that the legacy rounding is preferable.

findings.title: Document nesting limit differs
findings.legacy: Accepts these array-nested documents; token document parser has MAX_DOCUMENT_RECURSION=256.
findings.schema: Rejects these cases; JSON codec has a shared max depth of 128.

findings.title: XML child elements can set attribute-only members
findings.legacy: Ignores <token>x</token> for @xmlAttribute token.
findings.schema: Accepts the child element and sets token=x.

findings.title: Incomplete XML map entries are silently dropped
findings.legacy: Missing key or value is a 400 error.
findings.schema: Drops the incomplete entry and invokes the handler with an empty map.

findings.title: Multiple scalar XML union variants are rejected
findings.legacy: For Choice with string then integer children, parseMember for scalar variants overwrites the earlier variant; handler receives Integer(1).
findings.schema: Schema union walker rejects a second variant with HTTP 400.
findings.note: The finding is specifically demonstrated for scalar variants; legacy aggregate variant accumulation takes a different branch.

findings.title: Modeled XML error gains a Content-Type header
findings.legacy: When the operation output is empty, modeled Oops error has no Content-Type, despite an XML error body.
findings.schema: Adds application/xml; status and body match.

findings.title: Event payload no longer overwrites an event header
findings.legacy: Frame header header=outside followed by payload {header:inside,text:hello} exposes header=inside.
findings.schema: Excludes event-header members from payload schema and keeps outside.
findings.note: Schema keeps the modeled binding boundary; reproducing the legacy overwrite would be a separate behavior decision.

findings.title: CBOR initial frame failure response body differs
findings.legacy: Initial-frame read failure becomes a validation response with literal bytes "response error" under application/cbor.
findings.schema: Returns the empty CBOR map a0, also HTTP 400.
findings.note: The legacy body is not a correctly encoded CBOR error object.

findings.title: RPC CBOR streaming blob input public type differs
findings.legacy: Generated input field type is aws_smithy_types::blob::Blob.
findings.schema: Generated input field type is aws_smithy_types::byte_stream::ByteStream; observed bytes match.
findings.note: Harness adapts the consumption API and records type_name_of_val explicitly; this is not disguised as a wire difference.

findings.title: Streaming event error detail gains a context prefix
findings.legacy: Error source describes the invalid content type or UTF-8 directly.
findings.schema: Adds "failed to unmarshall Raw: " to the source description.

findings.title: Routing and request rejection diagnostic events disappear
findings.legacy: Routing emits "inside routing service call". Request failure can emit two debug diagnostics and an Upgrade trace event.
findings.schema: Schema routing lacks that routing message; DynUpgrade returns rejection responses without those failure diagnostics.
findings.note: Case names vary by protocol; raw per-protocol observations contain every event. This accounts for log-only differences in otherwise equivalent successful cases.

findings.title: Header serialization diagnostic formatting and redaction marker differ
findings.legacy: OperationBuildError includes field name and marker *** Sensitive Data Redacted ***.
findings.schema: SerdeError uses the marker {redacted} and different wrapping text. Both hide SECRET_HEADER.

findings.title: Validation response JSON object member order differs
findings.legacy: Generated serializer emits one field order.
findings.schema: Schema serializer emits another order for some validation responses. Parsed JSON values match.
findings.note: Byte-for-byte difference only for these observations. JSON object ordering alone is not a semantic protocol regression.

findings.title: Sensitive prefix-header output does not compile on legacy
findings.legacy: Nested unescaped quotes in renderPrefixHeader error format string cause Rust syntax failure.
findings.schema: Compiles.

findings.title: All-sensitive query map fails deny-warnings compilation on both paths
findings.legacy: Generated query sensitivity closure leaves name unused.
findings.schema: Same failure from the shared sensitivity generator.
findings.note: A shared codegen lint failure, not a schema-only regression.

findings.title: XML attribute parser leaves an unused setter on legacy
findings.legacy: set_token is dead code and fails -D warnings.
findings.schema: Compiles.
findings.note: Runtime XML corpus allows only dead_code; this separate probe preserves the strict compilation finding.
